title: field_ops.sale.confirmed v1
description: A route sale was confirmed (ADR-37 §18.4): its folio was assigned, its lines frozen with the price, tax and name of the catalog copy, and — for an autosale — its stock left the seller's truck in the same transaction (one field_ops.inventory.moved per line). A presale is confirmed with status confirmed and delivered later; an autosale is confirmed already delivered. A sale whose discount exceeds what is left of the seller's daily allowance is NOT confirmed (it waits as pending_authorization) and emits nothing. Emitted once per sale AFTER the transaction that confirmed it commits; confirming again, or a retried create with the same client_change_id, is not announced again. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex Workers.EventPublisher, relaying the [:alebrije_field_ops, :sale, :confirmed] telemetry event that AlebrijeFieldOps.Sales fires. The envelope is built by AlebrijeCommon.Events.Publish.build_envelope/3, so every field below lives under `data` (telemetry metadata stringified, measurements prefixed with m_). Amounts are decimal strings with at most two decimals, never floats.

sale_id.description: The field_ops.sales row. Stable: a consumer dedups on it.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the sale (ADR-25). Repeated inside data because the producer copies the telemetry metadata verbatim.

context_id.description: Branch (context) the sale was made in, when known.

seller_id.description: The salesperson (a field technician) whose folio series the sale belongs to.

folio.description: Consecutive per seller, assigned on confirmation: confirmed sales of one seller never leave a gap.

customer_crm_contact_id.description: The customer, a CRM contact WITH a phone (LEY DE ADMISIÓN); a merged contact resolves to its survivor before the sale is written.

modality.description: presale: ordered now, delivered later (field_ops.inventory.moved when delivered). autosale: sold and handed over from the seller's truck at once.

status.description: confirmed for a presale, delivered for an autosale.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of every amount below.

subtotal.description: Σ price × quantity of the lines, before discount and tax.

discount_total.description: Σ line discounts — all inside the seller's pre-authorized daily allowance (each line records it as discount_authorization: allowance).

tax_total.description: Σ line taxes: each rate Catálogo assigns to the item, on the line's base (price × quantity − discount), rounded half-up to cents per line.

line_count.description: Number of lines of the sale.

business_date.description: The tenant-local day the sale was confirmed in (branch timezone, else the tenant's): the day the allowance and the settlement count it against.

cancel_reason.description: Always null on confirmation; present because the producer emits one metadata shape for both sale events.
